A CONVERSATION ABOUT DIABETES

Diabetes. Let’s talk with care.

You deserve to be heard, and to have clear information about anything you are considering for your health.

Start with your questions

This page is a place to prepare questions about diabetes. Ask Dr Stevens for details about any herbal product you are considering and what to discuss before ordering.

Questions worth bringing

  • What are the exact ingredients, and what should I know before I choose them?
  • Could this fit alongside my medicines, supplements or current care plan?
  • What would Dr Stevens want to know about my circumstances before I proceed?
  • What is the best next step if I want a clearer answer?

Talk it through with Dr Stevens

Dr Stevens can explain the ingredients, use, suitability and the practical next step for your situation.

If you want a clearer answer, send a short message and let Dr Stevens guide the conversation.
